messages:
jules: quick follow-up on partner capability tokens. proposal: a proxy issues short-lived, signed capability tokens for partner integrations so long-lived API keys never leave partner infra. want to capture revoke model, offline refresh, and console UX.

anya: +1. revoke needs to be immediate. plan: token carries jti and we keep a revocation set in redis. token TTL 5m by default. on revoke we mark jti and deny refreshes.

dave: question: some partners have offline batching jobs that cannot call the proxy every 5m. option: issue an opaque refresh token that never leaves proxy/sidecar; sidecar exchanges refresh->capability. refresh has stricter policy and can be revoked.

jules: offline case noted. what about network partition? do we allow cached acceptance? i'd prefer no silent allow for write scopes. read-only could cache allow up to 30s with jitter.

anya: audit/telemetry: every issue/refresh/revoke emits structured event: event=token.issue token_id=t_123 orig_key=k_abc issuer=cap-proxy scope=embeddings:write exp=1777777300. index these so we can search by key or partner.

dave: policy eval must be two-layer: token claims (scope, proj list) + resource-level ACL lookup. never trust token alone for sensitive ops.

jules: sample token payload we discussed (JWT-like): `{"iss":"cap-proxy.redwood","sub":"partner:zen","jti":"t_123","scope":"embeddings:write","projects":["proj-1"],"exp":1777777300}`

anya: console UX: show active tokens per API key with last-used, TTL, and risk score. allow one-click revoke and show audit trail. also surface "stale tokens" that haven't been rotated.

dave: risk scoring ideas: scope weight (write>read), partner tier, anomalous geo/IP. block refresh automatically if anomalous.

security-bot: ACTIONS: create token-schema.md; implement redis revocation set; add console mockup; run pilot with a single partner.

jules: test plan: unit tests for revocation/refresh, integration test with sidecar exchange, chaos test where proxy is unavailable, perf target 50k token ops/s for top partners.

anya: ops: proxy needs quotas, CBs, circuit-breakers on backend calls. add emergency bypass flow for support with 2 approvals; log everything.

dave: also ship a tiny sidecar docker for partners that cannot change apps. docs + example compose file.

jules: i'll draft the addendum and attach console mockups. tagging @anya @dave for review. thanks :rocket:
file_note: Slack thread proposing partner capability tokens (proxy-issued), covering revocation, offline refresh, audit events, console UX, tests and ops
